reason: The cited evidence (E1) only addresses the castability, hardness, and remeltability of the CrCoFeMoNi+VC HEA itself, noting no pronounced HAZ after TIG remelting but warning of possible hot cracking. It provides no data on cold spray deposition, coating-substrate bonding, or performance under aggressive conditions, leaving most key premises unsupported.
premises: Low-heat, non-fusion deposition (cold spray) avoids hot-cracking by preventing base material melting and thermal gradients
HEA coating (CrCoFeMoNi + VC) has high hardness, wear resistance, and thermodynamic stability
HEA coating forms a dense, homogeneous microstructure that bonds effectively to the substrate
The coating preserves the base material's original microstructure, avoiding a deleterious HAZ
The repaired component will show mechanical performance comparable to or better than fusion-welded repairs
